verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents inboxes for agents, not team-shared inboxes. Nothing in the evidence describes multiple human team members working one inbox with shared conversation state, team seats, or team channels. Related pieces exist: IMAP/SMTP client access, labels for tracking conversation state, organization-wide thread retrieval, and cc-ing humans. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented shared-inbox collaboration capability.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
